learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.exploration: Stepped item two, three and four: equal theoretical chances one-half, one-third and one-quarter. Seed-one retained item three. Thousand four-item streams counted 236,250,257,257. Fifth arrival changed each exact chance to one-fifth and reran counts 195,197,191,214,203. No restart control visible after final state.
observations.reveal: Corrected to one-quarter through survival product one-half times two-thirds times three-quarters. Explained entry versus survival and equal bars, then fifth item and one-item memory without known stream length.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Exact fraction bars, current retained item, stochastic counts and dashed former quarter markers visible. Long formula and trial-draw lines clipped horizontally; final reveal lines extended below viewport. Development issue badge appeared but was not opened or used.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes, development issue details or other reviews inspected.

prediction.reason: Concrete survival probability requires a meaningful sequential commitment.
prediction.evidence: One-eighth chosen against one-quarter and one-half.

interaction.reason: Sequential arrivals, repeated trials and unexpected fifth item reveal fairness invariant.
interaction.evidence: Equal probabilities before and after fifth, with near-equal empirical counts.

payoff.reason: Reveal explains cancellation of survival factors and entry-survival tradeoff.

clarity.reason: Exact versus empirical labels help, but long formula lines clip.
clarity.evidence: Right ends of survival product and draw line not visible in screenshot.

transfer.reason: General streaming invariant and memory usefulness explained without a concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Unknown length and one stored item only.

accessibility.evidence: Text probabilities and counts available; screen reader, keyboard, contrast and reduced motion unaudited.

surprise.reason: Early and late items end with equal chances despite different arrival rules.
surprise.evidence: All four bars one-quarter, all five one-fifth.

visualExplanation.reason: Bars and factor labels connect selection and survival.
visualExplanation.evidence: Dashed quarter level versus fifth current bars.

playfulness.reason: Sequential arrivals and thousand-run check invite experimentation.
playfulness.evidence: Next, finish, fifth and repeated streams.

practicalValue.reason: Demonstrates uniform sampling with tiny memory.
practicalValue.evidence: One item retained without knowing final length.

depth.reason: Combines sequential probability, invariance and empirical validation.
depth.evidence: Telescoping survival product across unknown stream length.

complexity.reason: Small interface requires conditional survival probability and fraction products.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Separate chance to enter from surviving later replacement draws and distinguish one run from a distribution.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Four sequential contextual buttons; no visible final reset.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: Reciprocal replacement probabilities and stream sampling.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: Indexed i, fractions, chained products and empirical frequencies.

whyCool: One memory slot can remain fair to every item even when the stream keeps growing.
caveat: Horizontal formula clipping weakens the detailed explanation; empirical counts are seeded examples, not proof.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
